A tactical map illustration of the Battle of Ai. It shows a walled city (Ai) with a red arrow pointing out from it representing the King of Ai's army chasing a blue arrow (Joshua's main force) feigning retreat toward the wilderness. Another blue arrow, labeled 'Ambush (30,000 men)', points from behind a hill into the undefended city.

A split scene showing God's provision for Elijah. On the left, Elijah sits by a small stream (Brook Cherith) while a large black raven flies down carrying a piece of flatbread in its beak. On the right, Elijah stands speaking to a poor widow in Zarephath, who is holding a small jar of flour and a clay flask of oil near an empty cooking fire.
